contracts.name: Provider-Neutral Blueprint
contracts.rule: An Agent/Application Blueprint is a non-authoritative FA3-owned planning contract. It MUST NOT embed provider-native runtime objects as canonical execution state.

contracts.name: Task-Group Binding
contracts.rule: Every blueprint MUST bind to an explicit FA3 task group and compile into existing Orchestration Workforce work requests; it MUST NOT create a parallel scheduler or task registry.

contracts.name: Explicit Role Separation
contracts.rule: Planner/router, worker, reviewer, verifier and operator roles MUST be explicit task-scoped role context. A role MUST NOT grant capability, provider, model, tool, secret, resource or authority access.

contracts.name: Structured Handoff
contracts.rule: Cross-task handoffs MUST identify source task, destination task, relation type, required artifacts and whether integrity digests are required. Handoffs remain subject to orchestration dependency validation.

contracts.name: Independent Review
contracts.rule: When a blueprint declares independent review, the review task MUST use a REVIEWER or VERIFIER role distinct from the target task role and MUST run before the blueprint can claim reviewed completion.

contracts.name: Temporal Durable Lifecycle
contracts.rule: Temporal remains the sole global durable workflow lifecycle authority for blueprint-derived durable execution.

contracts.name: Bounded Conductor
contracts.rule: FA3 Adaptive Conductor or an admitted optional Conductor provider MAY manage only delegated task-local adaptive graphs and MUST NOT become a second durable lifecycle authority.

contracts.name: Unified Action and Tool Boundary
contracts.rule: Blueprint-derived effects MUST enter through FA3 Unified Action Fabric and applicable MCP/Security approval boundaries. Direct provider or tool execution from a blueprint is forbidden.

contracts.name: Model Routing Boundary
contracts.rule: Blueprints MAY name logical model needs but MUST NOT select a physical provider or model. FA3-AUTH-MODEL-ROUTER-001 remains the only model/provider/runtime routing authority.

contracts.name: Resource Boundary
contracts.rule: Blueprint resource requirements are requests only. Hardware Discovery is non-authoritative and HRB remains the exclusive host-resource admission, placement, reservation and lease authority.

contracts.name: Evidence and Provenance
contracts.rule: Blueprint compilation MUST preserve blueprint identity, revision and digest in downstream task metadata. Worker output remains a claim until independent Evidence/Gate verification.

contracts.name: Human Escalation
contracts.rule: Ambiguous role assignment, missing independent review, unresolved authority conflict or unrouteable task MUST fail closed to human escalation rather than silently widening scope.

contracts.name: Deterministic Compilation
contracts.rule: The same valid blueprint revision MUST deterministically produce the same normalized task, role, handoff and review projection before runtime-specific admission.

contracts.name: No Capability Inflation
contracts.rule: Blueprint templates are reusable configuration and orchestration composition only. They MUST NOT increment the capability baseline or introduce an architectural authority.

contracts.name: Runtime Promotion Separation
contracts.rule: A successfully compiled blueprint is not runtime admission. Any external specialist/provider still requires its existing scope-bound Current Host promotion evidence before production execution.

contracts.name: External Reference Isolation
contracts.rule: External starter repositories, API catalogs and service recommendations MAY inform blueprint design but MUST NOT become dependencies, providers or donor records without their separate FA3 admission paths.
